Sightings of identical Disc-Dome shaped UFO over Oslo, Norway in January 1994 and over UK in May 1994

#ufo #ufotwitter

My eyes never deceive me, it's the same Disc-shaped UFO seen over both Norway and UK in same year with a slightly bigger dome on top and with FAA lights, strange, isn't it?

Witnesses description from sighting in Norway

Flying object did not make any sound. It was flying over Oslo, the capital of Norway. There are some trees between me and the object which make some distortions.

What's even stranger is that a Russian patent perfectly matches the design of these unconventional aircraft; it's a crazy world we live in.
